Description of the accident (claimant's words)
I was a passenger in the front seat of our family car when we were struck in a parking lot on November 20, 2024 in
Pearland. My husband was driving slowly toward an open space near the store entrance when a vehicle backing out
of a neighboring spot hit the driver's side of our car. The impact pushed us sideways and the airbags deployed.
Everyone in the car was hurt: my husband had a sore neck and shoulder, I had bruising across my chest from the
seatbelt, and our two children in the back were crying and holding their arms. We stayed in the car until a store
employee came over and called for help. The other driver stopped and apologized, and gave us an insurance card
before leaving the scene. We were taken by ambulance to a nearby hospital for checks and were released the same
evening.

injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
